Vigneron Imports was founded in 1990 with a mission to feature authentic, regional French wines that consistently provide the highest levels of quality, character, and value, with the utmost respect for the environment.  Our portfolio features wines from established wine-producing areas such as Burgundy, Bordeaux, Beaujolais, Côtes du Rhone, Provence, Champagne, Alsace, and the Loire Valley, as well as exciting lesser-known regions and producers from Cahors and Gascogne in the Southwest, to Jura and Arbois in the East.
We are proud to work exclusively and directly with small to mid-sized family wineries from all regions of France. Most are bio-dynamic, sustainable, or transitioning estates and many have been granted the new and coveted HVE status, La Haute Valeur Environnementale. All of them are committed to use the least intrusive methods possible with an emphasis on nature, terroir, and exceptional grapes. The results are wines that make a lasting impression, all while allowing the flavors of each varietal, terroir, and appellation to shine. We are honored to have forged long-time relationships with dedicated and gifted family winemakers, Les Vignerons Independent. They are the reason our founding principles are firmly intact; to feature authentic wines of quality & value made with respect to the environment.
As always, whether we’ve known each other for years or are newly acquainted, we look forward to sharing our wines with you. Santé!

| Picture | ​It seems that although wine did not originate from France itself, that the influence this country has made on wine throughout history is truly unparalleled.  A land of endless beauty, a land with some of the most incredible wines on the planet, and a land that grows what the world considers the most notable grapes of all, France is full of tradition, great winemakers, and exceptional wines.  This country has a vast array of climates, soil types, and elemental influences that all come together beautifully to shows its unique, and one of a kind 'terroir.' Since its founding in 1979, North Berkeley has sourced authentic, expressive wines from France and Italy, destined for leading restaurants and wine shops as well as private cellars across the country.  With a retail store in Berkeley, California, well-established distributor partners in 26 U.S. states and multiple offices in Europe, our team is dedicated to providing all our customers with top-notch service and the finest wine selections the world over. Many of the regions in which we were first pioneers, are today household names—yet we’re still scouring the gorgeous French countryside for the next must-have wine. Discover our French wines. Wines from Italy
From the rolling, romantic hills of Piedmont to Sicily’s fiery volcanic slopes, Italy is a sensualist’s dream and a wine lover’s heaven. Nowhere else in the world will you experience such a rich selection of native grapes, each with its own character and flavor, than in Italy. Our partners from the bel paese are small family farms, many of which have roots that reach back centuries. Discover our Italian wines.
Wines from France
Our partners in France are true artisans, looking toward the future while respecting the traditions of the past. We’ve worked with not only mothers and fathers but also sons and daughters—who, after traveling the world, have come home with new ideas. Many of the regions in which we were first pioneers, are today household names—yet we’re still scouring the gorgeous French countryside for the next must-have wine. Discover our French wines.
